stem:
A youth soccer team has eight players. The table shows the height and the weight of each of the eight players.

Which scatterplot best represents the data in the table?

options.label: H
options.text: Scatterplot labeled H with incorrect point placements not matching the table data

options.label: G
options.text: Scatterplot labeled G with incorrect point placements not matching the table data

options.label: J
options.text: Scatterplot labeled J with incorrect point placements not matching the table data

visual_elements: Four scatterplots labeled F, H, G, J with weights on the y-axis and height on the x-axis
notes: The dataset matches exactly to scatterplot F among the four given options.
